metadataRaw.title: One Move to INSTANTLY Relieve Sciatica Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy at-home exercise that may instantly relieve sciatica pain.

The exercise focuses on decompression—a deep, opening stretch in the lower back that quickly reduces pressure on bulging or herniated discs, the main cause of pinched nerves and sciatica.

It’s a simple move you can use throughout the day whenever you need quick pain relief.
